document.title: Patchworks publication system
document.subtitle: A visual specimen for repeatable, high-quality client and thought-leadership documents
document.author: Patchworks AI

pages.title: One visual language, many kinds of document
pages.subtitle: Reusable page layouts and components for white papers, reports, briefs, case studies, playbooks and proposals

pages.title: Editorial, clear and recognisably Patchworks
pages.dek: The system carries the website's approved identity into a more disciplined print environment.

blocks.text: Instrument Serif creates a distinctive editorial voice. Source Sans 3 keeps detailed material calm, compact and easy to scan.
Paper, ink and restrained linework provide the base. Orange is used to locate attention, identify sequence and mark decisions. It should not become a decorative field competing with the content.

items: One clear argument or purpose per page.
Short eyebrows orient the reader without repeating the title.
Body text remains within a controlled measure.
Every component has a defined role and spacing rhythm.

blocks.label: System rule
blocks.title: Content should determine the component, never the other way around.
blocks.body: A publication can omit any component it does not need. Consistency comes from using the selected components faithfully.

pages.title: Statistics with context
pages.dek: Numbers are useful only when the reader can understand what they mean and where they came from.

blocks.text: A value, label and short note form a complete statistic. If a number is externally sourced, the publication should carry a human-readable reference nearby or on a dedicated sources page.

blocks.label: Illustrative data
blocks.title: This specimen describes the system itself.
blocks.body: Its numbers are implementation properties, not claims about a market, client or outcome.

pages.title: Use the same system at different levels of detail
pages.dek: Columns support comparison and sequence without forcing every document into a slide-like format.

columns.text: A brief or point of view can use a cover, two or three content pages and a closing page. The typography and chrome stay consistent without padding the argument.

columns.label: Best for
columns.title: Decision briefs and concise perspectives
columns.body: Use when the reader needs a focused argument, recommendation or course of action.

items.title: Orient
items.body: Establish purpose, audience and the question being addressed.

items.title: Develop
items.body: Build the argument with narrative, evidence, tables and examples.

items.title: Resolve
items.body: State implications, decisions, recommendations or next actions.

items.title: Evidence
items.body: Retain sources, assumptions and unresolved points in a usable form.

pages.title: Tables remain editorial rather than spreadsheet-like
pages.dek: Compact typography, strong headings and alternating rows support dense material without losing the visual system.

blocks.caption: The system is shared; the content architecture changes with the reader's job.

blocks.text: Long tables should be split deliberately across pages. The renderer will reject a table that exceeds the printable region rather than silently reducing its type size.

pages.title: Imagery carries meaning, not atmosphere alone
pages.dek: Approved editorial images can create pace and clarify systems when their relationship to the argument is explicit.

blocks.alt: Abstract connected systems artwork from the Patchworks editorial image set
blocks.caption: Existing Patchworks editorial master used to validate image embedding, cropping and caption treatment.

blocks.text: The default treatment uses the full available width and a controlled maximum height. The source remains embedded in the generated document, so the PDF does not depend on a network request.

pages.title: Evidence should remain readable after delivery
pages.dek: The publication must never expose internal tool tokens or depend on a hidden research trail.

blocks.text: A polished page cannot rescue an unsupported claim. The design system should make evidence easier to inspect.

blocks.label: Final check
blocks.title: Confirm the destination, not only the build.
blocks.body: Visual inspection, text extraction and embedded-font checks are all required before a publication is described as complete.

pages.title: Consistent by design. Flexible by composition.
pages.body: A controlled system for producing clear, credible and recognisably Patchworks publications across different audiences and document types.
